An '''enhancement jewel''' was a spherical component that could be used in a [[high-resolution projection system]] in conjunction with a [[Focusing lens/Legends|focusing lens]]. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Lowbacca]] used such a jewel, which he [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenged]] from components left by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], as a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] in his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
This component was first mentioned in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', a young reader's book published in [[1998]] and written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] as the fourth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series.<ref name="Lightsabers" />
